title: Quantum spectral curve as a tool for a perturbative quantum field theory
claim: Iterative perturbative solution of the QSC for any sl(2)-sector operator (Mathematica notebook); conformal dimensions of more than ten operators to 10 loops (Konishi included per later citations); proof that at any loop order the dimensions are multiple zeta values with coefficients in an algebraic number field fixed by the one-loop Baxter equation; observation that all computed results lie in single-valued MZVs times algebraic numbers.
scheme: No regularization: not a DR (or any Feynman-graph) computation. Planar spectrum obtained from the integrable AdS5 x S5 worldsheet S-matrix (asymptotic Bethe ansatz with BES/BHL dressing phase) plus finite-size corrections. Perturbative QSC.

proved: within QSC: MZV structure of perturbative dimensions at any order
assumed: all-loop integrability of planar N=4 SYM / AdS5 x S5 superstring
asymptotic Bethe ansatz with the BES/BHL dressing phase (exact worldsheet S-matrix)
identification of gauge-theory anomalous dimensions with string energies (AdS/CFT) in the planar limit

evidence: Abstract (paraphrased): 10 loops for more than ten operators; MZV theorem; SVMZV observation
red_flags: no field-theory test above five loops
notes: Pre-QSC Konishi was known only to five loops by independent methods (per the paper as quoted in search snippets) - six and eight loops by Y-system/FiNLIE.
